essence: A working miniature of the whole system. An isometric board where a process can be followed from end to end, with every place on one map.
explains_by: Explain by showing it work: one concept, then one concrete example followed across the board; the words on screen are labels, pins and counts, never sentences.
Show the whole system as one map, then follow one thing through it.
Place is meaning: each station is a stage of the process, the route between them is the order.
Height and count are amounts: stacks, bars and tallies on the board are the numbers.
Open close, widen out: start at one station, reveal the scale once the parts are known.

techniques.name: follow one through
techniques.how: one parcel, order or request travels station to station on B.route with it.travel; the camera holds each station

techniques.name: cutaway
techniques.how: it.cut opens the wall, the inside works

techniques.name: tracked subject
techniques.use: keeping the eye on the thing

techniques.name: isotype tally
techniques.how: B.tally counts units with the key

techniques.name: scale reveal
techniques.how: B.reveal or B.widen pulls back to the whole network once its parts are known

techniques.name: where it breaks
techniques.how: the route turns warn at the station that fails, a queue builds as a stack

vocabulary: three-tone solids on a true 30 degree grid
avoid: flat cards floating over the board
text-heavy beats (paragraphs, bullet lists, definitions spelled out on screen)
